description: List the Carbone tags a template uses and return a sample JSON dataset matching its structure. Call it before render_document when you do not know which data a template expects. Pass exactly one of templateId (a stored template: Template ID or Version ID) or template: a local file path, an HTTPS URL, or a base64-encoded string. It runs one render on the Carbone account and discards the document. {t()} translation tags are not listed.

template.description: Inline template to inspect, without storing it. Three input forms are accepted: (1) Local file path — absolute, e.g. "/Users/me/report.docx" (or "C:\Users\me\report.docx" on Windows), or under the home directory, e.g. "~/report.docx". A relative path must start with "./" or "../" and resolves against the server process's working directory, which is rarely yours: prefer an absolute path. A bare file name such as "report.docx" is NOT a path: it would be sent as base64 content. (2) HTTPS URL — the file is downloaded automatically, e.g. "https://example.com/file.pptx". (3) Base64-encoded string — the raw file content encoded as base64. Supported input formats: DOCX, XLSX, PPTX, ODT, ODS, ODP, ODG, HTML, XHTML, XML, SVG, IDML, MD, TXT, CSV, RTF, PDF. Carbone reads XML-based and text-based documents (plus PDF): the legacy binary Office formats DOC, XLS and PPT are rejected as input, although they are valid outputs. Re-save such a file as DOCX, XLSX or PPTX first. Mutually exclusive with templateId — provide exactly one, never both.

templateId.description: The ID of a stored template to inspect. Two ID formats are accepted: (1) Template ID (64-bit) — the deployed version is inspected. (2) Version ID (SHA-256) — that exact version is inspected. Both are returned by upload_template and list_templates. Mutually exclusive with template — provide exactly one, never both.

name: inspect_template

error.description: Error reported by Carbone while inspecting; only present when there is one.

sample.description: A sample dataset matching the template structure, with placeholder values: { "data": {...}, "complement": {...} }. Pass sample.data as render_document data, and sample.complement as complement.

signatures.description: Signature fields found in the template; only present when there are any.

tags.description: The Carbone tags of the template, as written, e.g. "{d.customer.name}", "{d.items[i].label}", "{c.company}". {t()} translation tags are not listed.

title: Inspect Template
